id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

user.description: The user context used to display user-specific information.

currentPath.description:
A UiSdlRoute path. Will be matched to all the available routes to find
a page to render.

routes.description: The routes that can be handled by this router

history.description: The browser history to be used by all components inside this router.

children.description: Children components to render in this layout.

onlyAllowMatchingRoutes.description:
A list of patterns that indicate what routes can be handled by the router.

If a route doesn't match any pattern, it will be ignored and reported via
{@see onUnhandledRoute}.

title:
UiSdlRouter manages rendered pages based on {@type UiSdlRoute} metadata.

This component type is private because it is automatically rendered
from a {@type UiSdlSite} and should not be used directly.
name: UiSdlRouter
